data.summary: This 12‑week plan starts with the student’s weak units—Differential Equations and Applications of Integration—then cycles through all remaining units, revisiting each before the exam. Each week is limited to the 2‑hour study window and includes concrete tasks that can be completed in one sitting. The last two weeks focus on mixed review and timed practice to solidify mastery.

tasks: Read the textbook section on 7.1 and write a summary of how to set up a basic differential equation.
Solve 3 example problems from the end of the section and check solutions.

weeks.focus: Continue Differential Equations and introduce slope fields
tasks: Draw slope fields for two simple differential equations. Label key features.
Explain in writing how slope fields help predict solution behavior.
Compute the average value of f(x)=x^2 on [0,2] using the integral definition. Verify with a Riemann sum approximation.

weeks.focus: Applications of Integration – position, velocity, acceleration
tasks: Given v(t)=3t^2, find s(t) and a(t). Plot all three functions on the same graph.
Use the Fundamental Theorem to evaluate ∫_0^4 (2x+1)dx. Interpret the result as accumulated change.

weeks.focus: Applications of Integration – area between curves
tasks: Find the area between y=x^2 and y=2x on [0,2] by setting up and evaluating the integral.
Rewrite several limit problems using algebraic manipulation. Show each step clearly.
Estimate limits from a given graph and a table of values. Compare with exact calculations.

weeks.focus: Algebraic limit properties and differentiation definition
tasks: Prove the limit of a sum equals the sum of limits using epsilon-delta style reasoning. Then compute the derivative of f(x)=x^3 at x=2 using the definition.
Differentiate y=sin(x^2) using the chain rule. Then find dy/dx for x^2y+xy^2=1 at x=1.
Take a full-length timed practice exam covering all topics. Review errors and create a one-page summary of common mistakes.

weeks.focus: Final mixed review and exam strategy
tasks: Do a second timed practice exam focusing on speed. After completion, outline a one‑minute review plan for each major topic to use on exam day.

data.final_week_advice: In the final week, prioritize quick recall drills and mental math practice. Focus on pacing, reading questions carefully, and managing time across multiple-choice and free-response sections. Stay calm, review key formulas, and get a good night’s sleep before the exam.
